name: Oh, Sweet Fate!
source:
You're in a predicament. You just lost your job and home due to your ex-boyfriend’s public display of insanity.
All you have is an e-bestfriend, a train ticket, and hope the dust settles down once you find a proper job. Well… the stars might not align the way you hoped they would.

[From [url=https://tqfox-studio.itch.io/oh-sweet-fate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你陷入困境了。由于你的前男友公开表现出疯狂，你刚刚失去了工作和家庭。
你所拥有的只是一个电子好友、一张火车票，希望一旦你找到合适的工作，一切都会尘埃落定。嗯……星星可能不会按照你希望的方式排列。

[来自[url=https://tqfox-studio.itch.io/oh-sweet-fate]itch.io[/url]]
